title: QCC Compiler Pass Diagnostic Report
description: Versioned machine-readable diagnostic record describing the execution effects, measurements, provenance, and verification status of an individual compiler pass (Roadmap v3.1, Milestone M8, Phase 71).

schema_id.description: Canonical schema identifier for QCC per-pass diagnostic reports.

pass_id.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for the pass (e.g. 'identity_elimination', 'sabre_routing').

pass_name.description: Human-readable display name of the pass.

execution_order.description: 0-based execution sequence index within the compiler/pipeline run.

pass_config.description: Configuration parameters and thresholds provided to this pass, if any.

algorithm.description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for fingerprinting.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest of canonical input circuit representation, or null if unavailable.

output_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 digest of canonical output circuit representation, or null if skipped/failed/unavailable.

semantic_equivalence_guaranteed.description: Explicit invariant: input_fingerprint == output_fingerprint indicates structural identity of serialization, NOT mathematical unitary equivalence.

per_gate_counts.description: Histogram mapping lower-case gate mnemonic to frequency count.

logical_swaps.description: Number of SWAP gates present in the input logical circuit specification.

router_swaps_inserted.description: Number of physical SWAP gates inserted by the router.

final_emitted_swaps.description: Number of SWAP operations present in the final physical emission.

circuit_depth.description: Critical path dependency depth in the circuit DAG.

cost_metrics.description: Hardware-dependent cost evaluation (e.g. latency, error, duration), or null if uncomputed.

before.description: Circuit snapshot metrics before pass execution, or null if skipped/unmeasured.

after.description: Circuit snapshot metrics after pass execution, or null if skipped, failed, or unmeasured.

duration_ms.description: Nondeterministic runtime telemetry: wall-clock duration of pass execution in milliseconds (null if unmeasured, unavailable, or not applicable).

availability.description: Explicit availability classification mapping metric or snapshot names to 'available', 'not_measured', 'unavailable', or 'not_applicable' without fabricating metric values.

expression.description: Exact algebraic or symbolic expression for the phase shift.

operations_added.description: Number of new operations inserted into the circuit DAG by this pass.

operations_removed.description: Number of operations deleted from the circuit DAG by this pass.

operations_rewritten.description: Number of existing operations replaced or rewritten in-place by this pass.

global_phase_adjustment.description: Net global phase shift introduced by this pass, or null if phase was unchanged.

analysis_invalidations.description: List of analysis IDs or compiler caches invalidated by this pass's mutations.

status.description: Explicit verification status. 'passed' indicates the specified verifier satisfied its equivalence criterion within its declared operational scope and numerical tolerances (not an axiomatic formal mathematical proof). INVARIANT: 'not_run' and 'unsupported' must NEVER be reported as 'passed'.

verifier_name.description: Identity of the verifier engine (e.g. 'qcc_internal_statevector', 'qiskit_independent_oracle', or null if not_run).

verifier_version.description: Version string of the verifier engine, or null if not_run.

verifier_mode.description: Verification method: 'exhaustive_unitary', 'sampled_statevector', 'matrix_norm', or null if not_run.

provenance.description: Verification origin: 'internal' (in-tree QCC verifier), 'independent_oracle' (external black-box oracle), or null if not_run.

tolerances.description: Comparison tolerance parameters applied (e.g. atol, rtol, frobenius_tol), or null if not_run.

detail.description: Diagnostic details, error explanations for failures, or justification for unsupported classification.
